spans.s:
अर्ध, i. e. ऋध् + अ.
 I. adj., f. धा. Half, halved,

.
 --Often former part of comp. words: -पण, Half a paṇa,

. -अक्त, Half spoken, Pañc. 77, 2. -दगध, Half burnt, Pañc. 98, 1.
 --When before cardinal numerals it denotes:
 1. A half more, e. g. -त्रयोदशन्, thirteen and a half, Yājñ. 2, 265.
 2. A half of the following number more, e. g. -शत, hundred and fifty,
. Division of the following number, [] -पञ्चाशत्, twenty-five,

.
 --When an ordinal follows a half is added, e. g. -तृतीय, three and a half,

.
 --When it follows a cardinal numeral, this numeral is divided, e. g. दशार्ध, i. e. दशन्-, Five,

.
 III. m. A part, e. g. जघन-, the rear of an army,
. पश्च-, The hind-part, Śāk. d. 7. पूर्व-, The former part,

.
 --Cf. अर्ध-भाषर.
 2. An arrow with a head like a half-moon,

; cf. 6, 36, 77.
 3. The hand bent into a semicircle or the shape of a claw, as for the purpose of seizing or clutching any thing. अर्धचन्द्रं दा. To seize one by the neck, Pañc. 63, 24.
अर्धभाज्, i. e. अर्ध-भज्, adj. Getting a half of,
(अर्धचन्द्र-, loc. At noon on the day of the halfmoon, i. e. on the eighth day of the month).
अर्धरात्रार्धदिवस, i. e. अर्ध-रात्र-अर्ध-दिवस, m. The equinox,

अर्धिक, i. e. अर्ध + इक, adj., f. की, Amounting to the half, Yājñ. 2, 296.
 --Comp.
आर्धिक, (i. e. probably अर्ध + इक), m. A labourer in tillage,
अर्धिन्, i. e. अर्ध + इन्, adj., f. नी, Entitled to a half,
अर्धोरुक, i. e. अर्ध-ऊरु + क, n. A petticoat, Daśak. in
+ अवशेष अर्ध- + अवशेष, adj. of which a half is left,
+ आसन अर्ध- + आसन, n. half a seat, Śāk. 97, 10.
+ तनु अर्ध- + तनु, f. half a body.
+ त्रयोदशन् अर्ध- + त्रयोदशन्, Thirteen and a half, Yājñ. 2, 165.
+ पञ्चम अर्ध- + पञ्चम, adj. four and a half,

+ पण अर्ध- + पण, m. half a paṇa (see
 6),
+ पथिन् अर्ध- + पथिन्, m. the half of a way, Pañc. 134, 17.
+ पादिक अर्ध- + पादिक, adj. Consisting in the loss of half of one foot, 8, 325.
+ मार्ग अर्ध- + मार्ग, m. mid-way, Vikr. d. 3.
+ मास अर्ध- + मास, m. half a month, a fortnight,
+ मौलि अर्ध-इन्दु- + मौलि, adj. epithet of Śiva (wearing the crescent as diadem),
+ उक्त अर्ध- + उक्त, adj. half uttered; ˚तेन, instr. without finishing one's speech,
+ शत अर्ध- + शत, n. a hundred and fifty,
+ सीरिन् अर्ध- + सीरिन्, i. e. अर्धसीर + इन्, m. A cultivator who takes half the crop for his labour, Yājñ. 1, 166.
